operation_items.operation: a matching binder governs occurrences in its body
resolve each occurrence against its own scope

prompt_intro: The crate builds, but `occurrences` increments the binding depth for every quantifier instead of only for a quantifier binding the queried name, so a variable under an unrelated binder is misclassified. Classify each occurrence as `Free` or `Bound(d)`, where `d` is one less than the number of same-name binders enclosing the occurrence (zero for the outermost). Keep the public API.

shared_operation.definition: Resolve each occurrence against the nearest enclosing binding for that name, distinguish free from bound occurrences, reject or reject-free an unbound name as the surface requires, and never leak an inner scope.
shared_operation.name: quantifier/scope resolution
shared_operation.transfer_rule: A surface is solved only when every task on that surface passes; the trio win requires all three surfaces and is never pooled across them.
